name: Martial Impetus
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and is goaded. (It attacks each combat if able and attacks a player other than you if able.)
Whenever enchanted creature attacks, each other creature that's attacking one of your opponents gets +1/+1 until end of turn.
blocked_sentences: Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and is goaded. (It attacks each combat if able and attacks a player other than you if able.)

needs.what: a continuous static (affects: {attached: true}) that keeps the enchanted creature goaded by the Aura's controller for as long as the static applies: it attacks each combat if able and attacks a player other than the goader if able, it sets goaded_by so the `goaded` selector/trigger filter sees it, and the mark ends the moment the Aura leaves or moves
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Goad exists only as the one-shot `goad` op (until the goader's next turn, or duration 'permanent' for the rest of the game), so a self_enters trigger would outlive the Aura and is not a static. The statics `attacks_if_able` plus `cant_attack_you` are not goad: `cant_attack_you` forbids attacking the Aura's controller outright, whereas goad only prefers another player 'if able', and neither marks goaded_by for the `goaded` filter
